name: Baldin, Century Herdmaster
oracle_text:
During your turn, each creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
Whenever Baldin attacks, up to one hundred target creatures each get +0/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
blocked_sentences: During your turn, each creature assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.

needs.what: a static effect (Doran, the Siege Tower style) making each creature matching `affects` assign combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power, usable with a static `condition` such as {"is_your_turn": true}; combat damage assignment must read toughness instead of power for affected creatures
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No entry in static_effects changes which characteristic combat damage is assigned from: set_pt/buff change real power (wrong for every other power-reading effect and wrong for toughness), replace_damage only multiplies or adds to an amount, and all_damage_wither changes damage results not the amount assigned
